description: This file defines the RemoteDispatcher interface for a remote service execution system within the Apache OFBiz framework. It declares methods for synchronous and asynchronous service invocation, scheduling jobs, and handling remote exceptions.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcher
classes.description: A Java interface for remote service dispatching, supporting synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled execution of services.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Run the service synchronously with the provided context, optional timeout, and transaction requirement.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Run the service synchronously but ignore the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Run the service asynchronously, passing a requester to receive the result.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Run the service asynchronously and return a waiter object to get the result later.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedule a service to run asynchronously at a specific time with recurrence options.
